name: Stock Research Desk
tagline: Scores companies for a five-year holding view and stops at the research memo
description: Ask it to look at a company and it works the case on a roughly five-year horizon, scoring quality with a gauge that weights management strength and a contrarian read of the story. What comes back is a research memo you can argue with, not a trade, and it places no orders of any kind.
author: HassiOnTheMoon
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
